lemmas.primary_translation: in sports, a card a referee shows a competitor who is expelled from a competition or match; contradiction, objection

definitions.text: i idrett: kort som dommer viser til utøver som blir utvist fra konkurranse eller kamp
definitions.translation: in sports: a card that a referee shows to a competitor who is expelled from a competition or match

examples.no: flere av debattantene burde ha fått rødt kort
examples.en: several of the debaters should have been given a red card
